bio.text: Deborah Adeimy is the Republican nominee for Florida's 23rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 18 primary.
She was born in West Palm Beach, Florida.

In a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey from 2021, she described herself as a fourth-generation Floridian and Certified Financial Planner who has served as a strategic advisor at Merrill Lynch, Citi Global Markets and Morgan Stanley.
